title: [Snyk] SNYK-PYTHON-TORCH-10337834 in torch@2.11.0
description:
## Out-of-bounds Write

**Severity:** medium
**Package:** torch@2.11.0
**File:** `pyproject.toml`

**CVSS Score:** 4.8  
**Exploit Maturity:** proof-of-concept  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 347/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2025-3121](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-3121)

**Fix:** No automatic fix available. Review manually.

### Details
## Overview
[torch](https://pypi.org/project/torch) is a Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Out-of-bounds Write through the `torch.jit.jit_module_from_flatbuffer` function. An attacker can corrupt memory by manipulating the input data to this function.
## Remediation
There is no fixed version for `torch`.
## References
- [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/149800)
- [Vulnerable Code](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/f34ab1628b6798cc62f55260dfad872f5df8fd94/torch/jit/_serialization.py#L197)


### Reference
- [Snyk advisory](https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-PYTHON-TORCH-10337834)
